name: dsh-workdesktop
description: A local-first workbench panel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): system/device status, calendar & todos from your local CLIs, recent recordings, local knowledge base, a cross-source layer (today's decision surface, business objects as an attribute of matters/inflow/insights, disposition ledger, cross-source consistency checks, judgement-quality ledger), and the Project Graph panel.
author: DSH Workdesktop contributors
